ohpm_mappings.description: AppGalleryConnectSDK hmcore for OpenHarmony.
ohpm_mappings.note: Firebase app initialization -> AGConnect core. hmcore reads agconnect-services.json, the direct analogue of google-services.json, and bootstraps the AGC serverless/growth SDKs.

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Huawei Mobile Services Library
ohpm_mappings.description: AppGalleryConnectSDK hmcore for OpenHarmony.
ohpm_mappings.note: FirebaseOptions carries the google-services.json values; the AGConnect equivalent is read from agconnect-services.json by @hw-agconnect/hmcore.

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Huawei Mobile Services Library
ohpm_mappings.description: AppGalleryConnectSDK hmcore for OpenHarmony.
ohpm_mappings.note: RN Firebase app module -> AGConnect core initialization. Sibling RNFirebase modules route elsewhere: .messaging -> @kit.PushKit, .analytics -> @kit.AnalyticsKit (native kits, not OHPM).

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Huawei Mobile Services Library
ohpm_mappings.description: AppGalleryConnectSDK hmcore for OpenHarmony.
ohpm_mappings.note: Same product, HarmonyOS edition. An app already using AGConnect on Android moves to the @hw-agconnect ohpm packages; hmcore is the core/init component.

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Huawei Mobile Services Library
ohpm_mappings.description: APMS Harmony SDK. collect crash, anr and performance info
ohpm_mappings.note: Crash/ANR/performance reporting -> AGC APMS. README confirms automatic collection of crash and ANR stacks with quality reports generated on AppGallery Connect.

ohpm_mappings.description: Tencent WeChat OpenSDK
ohpm_mappings.note: Official Tencent WeChat OpenSDK for HarmonyOS - supports WeChat share, favourites and payment, matching the Android opensdk surface.

ohpm_mappings.description: alipay standard cashier sdk for ohos
ohpm_mappings.note: Official Alipay cashier SDK - H5 payment, native app payment, H5-to-native handover and standalone signing. NOTE: minSdkVersion 13. The bundled com.alipay.apmobilesecuritysdk / tscenter device-fingerprint internals have no separate package and are left unmapped.

ohpm_mappings.description: lottie是一个适用于OpenHarmony的动画库，它可以使用Bodymovin解析以json格式导出的Adobe After Effects动画，并在移动设备上进行本地渲染
ohpm_mappings.note: Direct port - parses Adobe After Effects animations exported as JSON via Bodymovin and renders them on device. NOTE: the upstream README now recommends @ohos/lottie-turbo (popularity 9473) for new projects - declarative API, parallel loading, in-memory caching and sub-thread rendering for a ~30% performance gain. @ohos/lottie is kept here as the 1:1 migration target.

ohpm_mappings.description: Implementation of ImageView for ohos that supports zooming, by various touch gestures.
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port maintained under openharmony-sig: zoom, pan and rotate on an image view. Ranked below @rv/image-preview (popularity 1300) on popularity but chosen on function - that package is a Swiper-based lightbox gallery, not a zoomable ImageView.

ohpm_mappings.description: Highly configurable, easily extendable deep zoom view for displaying huge images without loss of detail. Perfect for photo galleries, maps, building plans etc
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port maintained under openharmony-sig: tiled deep-zoom rendering of very large images without loss of detail.

ohpm_mappings.category: Storage and Database > Storage > Key-Value Storage
ohpm_mappings.description: The official OpenHarmony package of MMKV. An efficient, small mobile key-value storage framework developed by WeChat.
ohpm_mappings.note: Official Tencent MMKV port (upstream repo github.com/Tencent/MMKV). NOTE: native @kit.ArkData preferences also covers key-value storage and android.content.SharedPreferences -> @kit.ArkData is existing precedent; MMKV is the mmap-based option for performance-critical cases, so this is the migrator's choice rather than a forced dependency.

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Programming Assistant Tool > Static Code Analysis > String Encoding Detection
ohpm_mappings.description: juniversalchardet是一款字符编码高效识别检测库。
ohpm_mappings.note: The Android library IS juniversalchardet, and this is its openharmony-sig port. Detects UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO-8859 and Asian encodings from a byte stream. Native util.TextDecoder (@kit.ArkTS) decodes a KNOWN encoding but cannot detect an unknown one, so there is no native path for this. Runner-up @ohos/jchardet (popularity 34) is a different, smaller library.

ohpm_mappings.description: gif-drawable是专门为OpenHarmony打造的一款GIF图像渲染库
ohpm_mappings.note: Exact port of android-gif-drawable, maintained under openharmony-sig. NOTE: native @kit.ImageKit (createPixelMapList / getFrameCount) decodes GIF frames and ArkUI displays them, but has no play/pause/seek/speed control - ImageAnimator is not in the API index. This package adds that playback control, so it is the migrator's choice rather than a forced dependency (same shape as com.tencent.mmkv).

ohpm_mappings.description: Extracts Exif, IPTC, XMP, ICC and other metadata from image, video and audio files
ohpm_mappings.note: Direct port of Drew Noakes' metadata-extractor. NOTE: native @kit.ImageKit (getImageProperty / getImagePropertySync / modifyImageProperty) already covers image EXIF, which is the common case; this package earns its row only on the superset - IPTC/XMP/ICC and audio/video container metadata. If an app uses com.drew only for image EXIF, prefer the native path.

ohpm_mappings.description: Extracts Exif, IPTC, XMP, ICC and other metadata from image, video and audio files
ohpm_mappings.note: XMP parsing rides along with the metadata-extractor port, which reads XMP alongside EXIF/IPTC/ICC. Direct port of Drew Noakes' metadata-extractor. NOTE: native @kit.ImageKit (getImageProperty / getImagePropertySync / modifyImageProperty) already covers image EXIF, which is the common case; this package earns its row only on the superset - IPTC/XMP/ICC and audio/video container metadata. If an app uses com.drew only for image EXIF, prefer the native path.

ohpm_mappings.description: Implementation of ImageView for ohos that supports zooming, by various touch gestures.
ohpm_mappings.note: Stream's maintained fork of com.github.chrisbanes.photoview -- same classes (PhotoView, PhotoViewAttacher, CustomGestureDetector), so it follows that row to the same port. Package re-checked against the registry 2026-10-02 (body is a dict).

ohpm_mappings.description: 适用于openharmony环境的JSON Web Token 实现
ohpm_mappings.note: JWT create/parse/verify. Natively, JWT appears only as Account Kit's ID token (harmonyos-guides/application-services/account-kit/faqs) - not a general JWT library; @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit has the HMAC/RSA primitives but no token format, so the port earns the row. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.category: Storage and Database > Storage > Disk Cache Library
ohpm_mappings.description: 专门为OpenHarmony打造的一款磁盘缓存库，通过LRU算法进行磁盘数据存取。
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port of Jake Wharton's DiskLruCache (registry: 'disk cache library, LRU'). Hand-rolling it on @kit.CoreFileKit fileIo is the native alternative. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.description: ArkTS interfaces of webrtc for OpenHarmony.
ohpm_mappings.note: PeerConnection / ICE / SDP / DataChannel - the half v1.10.0 left unmapped because no kit does it. Native org.webrtc.audio (@kit.AudioKit) and org.webrtc.Camera (@kit.CameraKit) are longer prefixes and keep winning their packages. The port exposes ArkTS (W3C-style) interfaces, not org.webrtc's Java API, hence medium. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.category: Network Communication > Short-Range Communication > Bluetooth Communication
ohpm_mappings.description: Bluetooth tools, mainly involving beacon area monitoring and beacon equipment ranging
ohpm_mappings.note: Beacon region monitoring and ranging - AltBeacon's own core work, which slice 2b found NO native counterpart for (ble.startBLEScan is transport only). Function matches the registry description; that it is a line-by-line port is not verified, hence medium. Closes a gap v1 recorded as confirmed. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.description: ohos_grpc_node是一个高性能的远程过程调用（RPC）框架,旨在简化和优化分布式系统中的服务通信.
ohpm_mappings.note: gRPC client. v1 rejected io.grpc.okhttp -> NetworkKit because 'you need a gRPC client'; this is one (ohos_grpc_node, registry: Network Communication > RPC). API shape is grpc-node's, not grpc-java's stubs. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.category: Graphics > Graphics Rendering > Animation Rendering > Cross-Platform Animation Rendering Engine
ohpm_mappings.description: libpag（便携式动画图形）文件的渲染库，可跨多个平台本地渲染 After Effects 动画
ohpm_mappings.note: Tencent PAG animation renderer; the port renders the same .pag files (registry: cross-platform After Effects animation rendering). Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.description: Rive animation engine for HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony - Lightweight, High Performance, Cross Platform vector animation library
ohpm_mappings.note: Rive vector animation runtime for HarmonyOS. Reverses the 2026-10-02 round-1 rejection, which claimed no port existed - it was missed by searching for the wrong name. State-machine/data-binding parity unverified, hence medium. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.description: Memory Efficient Serialization Library
ohpm_mappings.note: FlatBuffers serialization; same schema and wire format (registry: Serialization > Binary). Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.note: SIP voice/video calling. The port supports one-to-one calls only (registry description); conferencing and Linphone's full account/chat stack are not claimed. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.note: MessagePack binary serialization; same wire format. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.category: Graphics > Graphics Rendering > Animation Rendering > Spring Physics Simulation
ohpm_mappings.description: rebound is a simple library that models Spring dynamics for the purpose of driving physical animations.
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port of Facebook Rebound spring dynamics. ArkUI's springMotion curves are the native alternative for simple cases. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.description: 专门为OpenHarmony打造的一款用于处理压缩解压和归档格式的API库，致力于更轻便、更简单
ohpm_mappings.note: Archives and compressors (tar, 7z, ar, bzip2, xz...). zip/gzip alone are native - zlib in @kit.BasicServicesKit - so this row earns its place only on the superset, as metadata-extractor's does. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02 (body is a dict; negative control False).

ohpm_mappings.category: Tool Library > Third-Party SDK > Data Analytics SDK
ohpm_mappings.description: GrowingAnalytics for HarmonyOS SDK.
ohpm_mappings.note: The vendor's own HarmonyOS SDK (publisher growingio). A vendor analytics SDK's core work is delivering events to that vendor's backend, which no kit does (hiAppEvent records, it does not deliver to GrowingIO) - so native-first does not apply. Covers com.growingio.android.* and the Flutter plugin namespace. Registry existence checked 2026-10-02.
